summary: Cayson Acquisition Corp, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting that its insiders deposited $125,000 into the trust account for the fourth monthly extension under a previously approved amendment allowing up to twelve monthly extensions to March 23, 2027. This is a routine trust funding, not a special-situation event — no business combination, tender, or activist campaign is announced. The filing merely updates on administrative steps toward an eventual de-SPAC. There are no deal terms disclosed. Watch for a target announcement or further extensions; no risk-arb angle applies until a definitive agreement is signed.
